title: Rent Billing Under the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: Anniversary Periods and First-Period Discounts
content:
**Billing rule.** Rent on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is billed on the anniversary basis. The first billing period starts on the move-in date and is charged at move-in; each later period starts on the same day of the month as the move-in date, and where a month has no such day the period starts on that month's last day. A billing period ends the day before the next period starts. The agreement runs month to month and its due dates follow anniversary billing.

**Amount charged.** The first period's rent is the monthly rent reduced by the move-in discount or the military discount, whichever is greater; the two never add. The move-in discount counts only where the first-month promotion is attached to the agreement, and the military discount only where the military discount is applied to the agreement. Every later period is charged the monthly rent, reduced by the military discount only where the military discount is applied. Amounts are rounded to the cent, half up. The discount rates are the class's rates.

**When rent is charged.** Rent is charged only while the rental agreement is in active, delinquent, lien noticed, auction scheduled or moving out status. For a rental in moving out status, a billing period whose start date falls on or after the planned vacate date is not charged. Each billing period is charged once; a second rent charge for a period that already carries one is not posted.

## Period calendar (hypothetical move-in on 31 January 2027)

| Period | Starts | Ends |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 31 January (charged at move-in) | 27 February |
| 2 | 28 February (February has no 31st) | 30 March |
| 3 | 31 March | 29 April |
| 4 | 30 April (April has no 31st) | 30 May |

## Worked amounts (hypothetical Bluegate Climate Controlled agreement, monthly rent $129.00)

| Agreement carries | First period | Each later period |
|---|---|---|
| first-month promotion and military discount | $64.50 (the greater discount, 50%, applies) | $116.10 (10% off) |
| military discount only | $116.10 | $116.10 |
| first-month promotion only | $64.50 | $129.00 |
| neither | $129.00 | $129.00 |

$129.00 reduced by 10% is $116.10; reduced by 50% it is $64.50.

## Status and vacate-date check

| Situation on the period's start date | Rent charged for that period |
|---|---|
| status active, delinquent, lien noticed or auction scheduled | yes |
| status moving out, period starts before the planned vacate date | yes |
| status moving out, period starts on or after the planned vacate date | no |
